name: Hotel Whistler
summary: A hotel on rue de Saint-Quentin, a short walk from Gare du Nord.
description: Hotel Whistler is at 36 rue de Saint-Quentin, in the 10th, the streets beside Gare du Nord. The listing presents it as a hotel rather than an apartment, which is why it is on this edit. The rate printed here is the Twin Room Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026.
facts: The checked room is the Twin Room
